Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
We all know that "Caitiff" is not a clan.
But is it possible to represent "no clan" in a storyline tournament, and
have a crypt 75% full of Caitiff?

Or, if you want to "represent the Caitiff" would you have to have a huge
crypt and a whole lot of methods of getting more vampires out?
(10 Caitiff, 30 Nosferatu, and Kindred Intelligence ;) )

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk wrote:
> We all know that "Caitiff" is not a clan.
> But is it possible to represent "no clan" in a storyline tournament, and
> have a crypt 75% full of Caitiff?

No.

> Or, if you want to "represent the Caitiff" would you have to have a huge
> crypt and a whole lot of methods of getting more vampires out?
> (10 Caitiff, 30 Nosferatu, and Kindred Intelligence ;) )

This would "represent the Nosferatu" in terms of Storyline "scoring", but
it is allowable.
